title: create instance
description: A lightweight modpack built around the Create mod and its addons, made for server play but available for everyone. Includes performance and QoL improvements for a smooth and fun experience.
body:
**Description:**
This modpack was created specifically for our server, but anyone can install it to join and play together.
The focus is mainly on the Create mod and its add-ons, bringing automation, engineering, and creative building to the game.
It includes a selection of performance and quality-of-life mods to make the experience smoother and more enjoyable, without straying too far from the vanilla feel.

Whether you want to design complex machines, build beautiful bases, or just explore with friends – this pack provides everything you need for a stable and fun gameplay experience.
